title: [Bug] Anthropic API Error: Cannot modify thinking blocks in assistant message
body:

     … +4 lines (ctrl+o to expand)

⏺ Bash(git diff src/controllers/auth_router.py | grep -A3 -B3 "1513\|_base_context" 2>&1 | head -20)
  ⎿  (No content)
  ⎿  Context low · Run /compact to compact & continue

  ⎿ Error: Error during compaction: Error: API Error: 400 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"invalid_request_error","message":"messages.1.content.14: `thinking` or `redacted_thinking` blocks in the latest assistant message cannot be 
    modified. These blocks must remain as they were in the original response."},"request_id":"req_011CVuC41MpFHWGxV8e4ZE8o"}
